description: A Lit-based custom web component for date and time input, supporting date, time, and datetime-local types with rendering, styling, and data binding logic.

classes.name: DateTimeInput
classes.description: A custom web component for date and time input, extending Root, with properties for value, label, enableDate, enableTime, and methods for rendering and data binding.

methods.name: #setBoundValue
methods.description: Sets the bound data value in the model based on user input.

methods.name: #renderField
methods.description: Renders the input field with label and styling.

methods.name: #getInputType
methods.description: Determines the input type ('date', 'time', 'datetime-local') based on enableDate and enableTime properties.

methods.name: #formatInputValue
methods.description: Formats a string value into the appropriate input value format based on input type.

methods.name: #padNumber
methods.description: Pads a number with leading zeros to two digits.

methods.name: #getPlaceholderText
methods.description: Returns placeholder text based on input type.
